messages.text:
"I would like to make a Raid Shadow Legends mobile game like clone, can you create 5 different factions, 5 legendary champions, 25 epic, and 25 rares. I need a way to summon the champions so I need 3 types of items to summon them - Blue Shard for rares and epics, Epic Shards for rares epics and legendary, and a Yellow shard for Epic and Rares. Every summoning item summons only 1 champion. 
I want it to be as close to a raid shadow legends clone as possible.

---

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
